releases.notes:
Harvester 1.0.0 is a stable release: automatic chain-harvesting of connected log/ore veins (and, newly, underground dirt/gravel, leaves, and mature wheat crops), driven entirely through the normal vanilla break pipeline — no new drops, no bypassed game rules.

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition Beta 1.7.3
- Babric / Fabric Loader `0.18.4`
- StationAPI `2.0.0-alpha.6.2`
- Java 17

## Installation (MultiMC)

1. Create or open a MultiMC instance already qualified for Babric + StationAPI on Beta 1.7.3 (Fabric Loader `0.18.4`, StationAPI `2.0.0-alpha.6.2`, Java 17).
2. Copy `harvester-b1.7.3-1.0.0.jar` into that instance's `mods` folder.
3. Launch the instance.

**Back up any world you care about before installing mods.**

## Key features

- In-game configuration screen (default config key `H`, rebindable in Controls) — no other mod required.
- Persistent configuration in `harvester.properties`, migrated in place across upgrades.
- Per-category and per-block filtering via allowlist/denylist.
- Tool gates per category: axe (logs), pickaxe (ores), shovel (dirt/gravel), shears (leaves), hoe (mature crops).
- Harvest drops consolidated at the origin block instead of scattered along the vein.
- Underground dirt and gravel, leaves, and mature wheat crops — all off by default.

## Multiplayer (optional)

Server-authoritative and off by default. The dedicated server needs Harvester installed to run the additional-block chain; the client only ever sends a single "I'm holding the key" boolean, and the server recomputes everything else (group, chain, tool check, drops, durability) itself. A StationAPI client without Harvester connects normally to a Harvester server and silently ignores the handshake. Each client opts in per server independently — enabling Harvester on one server never enables it on another, and it never changes singleplayer behavior.

## Safe defaults

Every new/expanded category (dirt, gravel, leaves, crops) ships disabled until you opt in. `multiplayerAllowed` defaults to `false` on the dedicated server.

## Compatibility

- A StationAPI client without Harvester connects normally to a Harvester server.
- A client without StationAPI is not compatible with a StationAPI server (Harvester or not) — a StationAPI-level requirement, not Harvester-specific.

- 10/10 final manual runtime tests passed (singleplayer, multiplayer, dedicated server), no reservations.

releases.notes:
**Pre-release — not the final stable version.** Additional functionality
and UX adjustments are still planned before a final `1.0.0` (see
[`docs/PRE_RELEASE_HANDOFF.md`](docs/PRE_RELEASE_HANDOFF.md) for the full
backlog: in-game configuration UI integration, drop consolidation onto
the originally-broken block, axe-only tree chains, per-category/per-block
toggles, and new block categories — dirt/gravel with shovel, leaves with
shears, mature-only crops with hoe). Behavior may change before `1.0.0`
ships.

**Back up any world you care about before testing this build.** Testing
and feedback are welcome — please report issues against this repository.

## What's in this build

- Ore and log vein harvesting: hold the activation key (`V`) while
  breaking a log or a specifically-tagged ore block to chain-break the
  connected group, through the normal vanilla break pipeline (normal
  drops, normal tool durability, normal tool-suitability gating).
- Deterministic BFS discovery over a configurable neighborhood
  (`legacy_26`, matching legacy Harvester 1.x, or `orthogonal_6`).
- File-based configuration (`harvester.properties`): `enabled`,
  `maxChain` (1–100, default 64), `neighborhood`, `diagnosticLogging`,
  `harvestLogs`, `harvestOres`, `multiplayerAllowed`.
- Optional, server-authoritative multiplayer support (off by default;
  requires both server `multiplayerAllowed=true` and a per-server client
  opt-in).
- 221 automated tests, 0 failures.

## Requirements

Minecraft Beta 1.7.3, Babric / Fabric Loader `0.18.4`, StationAPI
`2.0.0-alpha.6.2`, Java 17.
